1587bac57159: Change the app language · translationCore 4 Help
17845592efa5: Choose the language of the buttons, menus and messages in tC4. Until you choose one, tC4 follows the language of this computer; after you pick, it keeps that choice.
45563e5c8a97: Your translation and your projects do not change.
ee049a6941eb: Click the round person icon at the top right (1), then App language (2). The menu is the same on Home and inside a project.
dc7b6c5db74e: Click the Language box and choose a language.
3727c4ee54ba: The whole app switches to that language right away, so you can see what it looks like before you decide.
11954b3e0c6e: Click Apply to keep it. In Spanish the button reads Aplicar.
c83abfae8b10: To go back to the language you had, click Cancel or ✕ instead. translationCore remembers your choice the next time you open it.
f321bc45749b: Changes: menus, buttons, labels and dialogs, such as Understand, Translate and Check at the top of a project.
2b6bca26ac47: Doesn't change: your translation, the source texts (such as the ULT) and the translation helps (notes, words and questions). These stay in the language they were written in. To choose the language of the checking helps, see Checking language.
